question: v05
q: Petrol's killing me. How much more am I paying than a year ago?

transcript.answer:
Automotive fuel prices are **13.5% higher** than a year ago. That's the August 2026 figure from the ABS Consumer Price Index (August 2025 to August 2026, Australia, original series). The September 2026 figure isn't out yet.

The ABS measures fuel as a category that includes petrol and diesel, so I can't give you a per-litre price. As a rough guide, a $80 fill-up now costs about $11 more than it would have a year ago.

The increase has been bumpy. Fuel prices jumped 24.2% year-on-year in March 2026 and 18.6% in April, then fell 7.3% in June before rising again in August. Prices are moving a lot month to month, so the next few readings could look quite different.
